item.title: Adding Scrape Credentials to Node Exporter
item.description: 1. Background Node Exporter is a common component in the Prometheus ecosystem for collecting host metrics, but by default it does not provide access authentication. This article describes how to add basic authentication to Node Exporter in a Kubernetes environment to improve security. 2.
